name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
title: Endurance Technologies Ltd - 540153 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 14.5% and standalone revenue up 31% YoY, but ₹73.7 crore aluminium/steel cost inflation is unrecovered and standalone margin would be 13.3% ex-impact.

utilisation.quote: we did not have enough capacity in-house

capex.quote: We expect capital expenditure in FY 27 to remain similar to FY 26.

triggers.label: ABS capacity 6.4 → 18.4 lakh units
triggers.quote: adding 12 lakh units to our existing 6.4 lakh units per annum

triggers.label: Aluminium/steel cost ₹73.7 crore unrecovered
triggers.quote: If I just take the ₹73.7 crores impact of alloy and steel, which is completely a non-value add

triggers.label: ABS volume to double, 100-150% growth
triggers.quote: So I think the growth can be 100% to 150% compared to last year.

triggers.label: Inverted fork capacity 60k → 100k/month
triggers.quote: take our monthly sales of inverted front forks from 60,000 units to 75,000 units per month, by June 2026 and to 100,000 units per month by the end of FY 27

guidance.quote: to 100,000 units per month by the end of FY 27
We expect capital expenditure in FY 27 to remain similar to FY 26.

guidance.metric: Aluminium forging SOP / JLR and RE supplies
guidance.quote: Supplies to Royal Enfield will begin in June 2026, while supplies to Jaguar Land Rover are scheduled for August 2026.

guidance.value: Q1 volatile; much better numbers from Q2
guidance.quote: I see much better numbers from Q2.

red_flags.label: Unrecovered aluminium/steel cost; pass-through pending
red_flags.quote: many OEMs have already confirmed the rates, some have given the emails or PO amendments, some are still awaited

red_flags.label: Hero Electric inventory provision
red_flags.quote: For the inventory pertaining to Hero Electric we have taken a provision

evasions.topic: Battery pack OEM demand for solution
evasions.quote: This solution is for this OEM we are supplying to. There could be different solutions being asked by different customers.
